headline: Every tub of yoghurt checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to one of your plants
heroLede: With yoghurt, custard and dairy desserts sharing lines across your plants, every changeover is a chance for the wrong label or date. Here's what a camera check could look like on your tub lines. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every tub has its foil seal and lid on, pressed down flat all the way round. A lifted seal shortens shelf life and comes back as a store complaint.
labelLede: A vanilla tub and a strawberry tub look much the same with the lid on. The camera checks every tub carries the right label for the product inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: Chilled yoghurt and custard carry a use-by date that has to be right on every tub. The system reads the printed date and batch code and compares them with the product and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Lid offcuts, glove pieces and loose machine parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.
